shellCommands.command: git status --short; git ls-files | grep -v node_modules | head -100; grep -rn -i "prefetch\|related" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.js --include=*.jsx --include=*.vue --include=*.svelte . | grep -v node_modules | head -60

for f in app/*.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts package.json; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; git diff; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json

cd node_modules/next; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "unstable_forceStale\|unstable_prefetch\|unstable_dynamicOnHover" dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts dist/esm/client/app-dir/link.js dist/build 2>/dev/null | head; sed -n 1,200p dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | grep -n -i -B2 -A20 "prefetch?"
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rli "prefetch" . | head -30; grep -rn -i "unstable_instant\|prefetch = \|export const prefetch\|runtime prefetch\|unstable_prefetch" . | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit -p . ; echo tsc=$?; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30; echo build=$?
